title: Python Fundamentals
summary: Names, types, functions, control flow and collections - the working language of AI engineering.
objectives: Explain the difference between mutable and immutable values
Write and test small pure functions
Choose the right built-in collection for a task
Read a traceback to locate a bug
socratic_prompts: What happens to x if you append to y after writing y = x?
Why is a function that returns a value easier to test than one that prints it?
When would a dict be a better choice than a list?
